ValidationRule.description: Preserves the original key, account, location, product, and stocking unit.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(Stock_Key__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c), ISCHANGED(Location__c), ISCHANGED(Product__c), ISCHANGED(Stocking_Unit__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use a separate stock position for a different account, location, product, stocking unit, or key.
